description: Returns the signed-in player's seated view of a battle (battle) and what it expects next (next). next says what the battle expects: in setup, each step in table order with done and the command that answers it, the battlefields and secondary cards on offer, and begin.refusal until begin-battle would be accepted; in play, the round, phase, active player, a pending settlement of the previous turn, cards scoring now, the turn commands allowed now and why advance is refused, stratagems usable now per side, and the undoable seq. Requires mcp:read.
name: get_my_battle
title: Read one of my battles
